notes:
July 25th 2026
Version 13.1+ (stable) / 13.2+ (beta)
**********************
NEW!
* Right-click to enable/disable a section now works in the R-Editor, not just the Live Editor. (R)
* Browsing with unsaved changes now clearly confirms "Saved" before continuing. (R)
* In the program info popup, Enter now saves the name and closes it. (R)
* Several fixes and improvements. (K,R)
* See About → Release Notes for more information.
